about: Measured speed and turn-taking per curated stack, from staging calls on our own voice engine (India VM, browser test calls through the control plane with the synthetic Hinglish sim caller). shared/stack-gate.ts reads this file against the gate thresholds; shared/stacks.ts shows the reply gap from it. Replace an entry with each new staging run; a stack or a number not listed here is 'not measured', never zero. cutInRate is the share of caller turns she started speaking over; it has not been measured per stack yet (only on the turn bench).
